svg.title: Footnote
svg.desc: A lowercase a with a raised asterisk: a word with a note on it, the plainest sign that something is cited. The a is drawn from a circle and a stem, so there's no font to license, and at 16 pixels the asterisk becomes a spark at the corner. Weak where an asterisk alone means "required" or "new" in forms and toolbars, so the a has to carry it.
